instructions: Read old_text vs new_text for each entry and fill in should_approve, error_kind, reason, confirmed_by and confirmed_at. The proposed_* fields are intent-derived starting points and may be wrong -- that is why this file exists. Entries left unconfirmed are excluded from the study.

confirmations.old_text: The Processor shall process personal data only for the purpose of providing the Services and only on the documented instructions of the Controller. It is hereby expressly acknowledged and agreed between the parties that the Processor shall not process personal data for its own purposes, including for the training of machine learning models, without the separate written consent of the Controller.
confirmations.new_text: The Processor shall process personal data only for the purpose of providing the Services and only on the documented instructions of the Controller. The parties agree that the Processor shall not process personal data for its own purposes, including for the training of machine learning models, without the separate written consent of the Controller.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Removes legalese padding. No obligation is altered.

confirmations.old_text: The Processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure or access. Such measures shall include encryption of personal data in transit and at rest, role-based access control, and logging of access to production systems retained for not less than twelve (12) months.
confirmations.new_text: The Processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure or access. Such measures shall include: encryption of personal data in transit and at rest role-based access control logging of access to production systems retained for not less than twelve (12) months
confirmations.proposed_reason: Presentation only. All measures and the retention period survive.

confirmations.old_text: The Processor shall not engage a sub-processor without the Controller's prior written authorisation. Where authorisation is given, the Processor shall impose on the sub-processor data protection obligations no less protective than those set out in this DPA, and shall remain fully liable to the Controller for the performance of that sub-processor's obligations.
confirmations.new_text: The Processor may engage sub-processors at its discretion, provided it notifies the Controller afterwards. Where authorisation is given, the Processor shall impose on the sub-processor data protection obligations no less protective than those set out in this DPA, and shall remain fully liable to the Controller for the performance of that sub-processor's obligations.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Converts prior written authorisation into after-the-fact notification. The Controller loses its veto over who processes its data, reversing the control the clause exists to create.

confirmations.old_text: The Processor shall give the Controller not less than thirty (30) days' written notice of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor, during which period the Controller may object on reasonable data protection grounds.
confirmations.new_text: The Processor shall provide the Controller with at least thirty (30) days’ written notice of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor. During this period, the Controller may object on reasonable data protection grounds.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Clarity only. The period and the objection right are unchanged.

confirmations.old_text: Taking into account the nature of the processing, the Processor shall assist the Controller by appropriate technical and organisational measures, insofar as this is possible, in fulfilling the Controller's obligation to respond to requests from data subjects exercising their rights. The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay if it receives such a request directly, and shall not respond to that request itself unless instructed to do so by the Controller.
confirmations.new_text: Considering the nature of the processing, the Processor shall, insofar as this is possible, assist the Controller through appropriate technical and organisational measures in fulfilling the Controller’s obligation to respond to data subject rights requests. The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay if it receives such a request directly, and shall not respond to that request itself unless instructed to do so by the Controller.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Style only. The qualified assistance obligation is unchanged.

confirmations.old_text: The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours, after becoming aware of a personal data breach affecting personal data processed under this DPA. The notification shall describe the nature of the breach, the categories and approximate number of data subjects affected, the likely consequences, and the measures taken or proposed to address it.
confirmations.new_text: The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any event within thirty (30) days, after becoming aware of a personal data breach affecting personal data processed under this DPA. The notification shall describe the nature of the breach, the categories and approximate number of data subjects affected, the likely consequences, and the measures taken or proposed to address it.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Extends a hard regulatory deadline from 72 hours to 30 days. UK GDPR Article 33 requires notification without undue delay and within 72 hours; this makes the clause non-compliant.

confirmations.old_text: On termination of the Services, the Processor shall, at the Controller's election, delete or return all personal data processed on the Controller's behalf, and shall delete existing copies unless retention is required by applicable law. The Processor shall certify deletion in writing within thirty (30) days of the Controller's request. Signed on behalf of the parties on 05/06/2026.
confirmations.new_text: On termination of the Services, the Processor shall, at the Controller's election, delete or return all personal data processed on the Controller's behalf, and shall delete existing copies unless retention is required by applicable law. The Processor must provide written certification of deletion within thirty (30) days of the Controller's request. Signed on behalf of the parties on 5 June 2026.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Removes a real DD/MM versus MM/DD ambiguity by restating the same date unambiguously. The date itself does not move.
